title: Polo Ralph Lauren Classic Sport Cap Newport $59 + Shipping @ Woolworths Marketplace
body:
Deal: Polo Ralph Lauren Classic Sport Cap Newport $59 + Shipping @ Woolworths Marketplace

[TechieARG] My $3 Adidas cap order was cancelled. Maybe this is a good alternative.
[Craze] lol was gonna make a similar sarcastic comment… alas $59 =/= $3!
[BestTechAdvisor] It's not Adidas, but it is $3 and probably made in the same factory. $3 Dad Cap
[HansW] if thats the logic…. isn't most things? including the car you drive?
[Zeee] Logo , a badge can understand, and enough… No need to right polo polo polo like a poster everywhere
[gamemaster] Fashion brands have the most unfashionable cap designs in my opinion. $59 for this cap is buying a logo with a cap than a cap with a logo.
[Raynes] Do you think more design elements equals more fashion?
[King Steuart] I also buy my luxury brand clothing from Safeways
[Disabled-User] Where nothing will probabily go wrong…. Probably, that's the 1st thing that's ever gone wrong…
[Doineedthis] Hmm this or 19 x $3 kmart hats and $2 change?
[gamemaster] Treat yourself. And get 20 caps and pay the extra $1.
[GachaGamer] 19 hats, buy a sharpie for $2, draw the horse on those 19 hats, and then sell them off for a profit.
[Hinee] I don't even follow polo - what's the best team?
[ChibsQT] Identical looking product available from Taobao for $10. Prob made by the same kid, same factory too.
[2ndeffort] havent looked for a cap but I buy RL clothes 2nd hand from depop, regularly buy work RL shirts for around $30, bought a harrington jacket for about $50 posted, most in perfect nick. Bought a shirt once that was worn out and should have been in the bin but aside from that one outlier have bought a full work rotation of chinos and shirts for around what i would have paid for a single outfit at an RL shop.
[scottb721] If anyone's thinking of switching aftershave give their Polo Black a crack.
[MS Paint] Instructions not clear. I poured Polo Black down my crack and it stings bad.
[scottb721] It's a fine line between pleasure and pain!
[Bimbobob] About as silly price as the several hundred dollar brothel creepers that were "on special" recently.
[djmm] Guys buy these to show our support to those kids in Pakistan factories
[spock] This Brands should be pay us for advertising there products when wearing them .
[oatmatcha] Genuine question - any recommendations for similar caps? I like the softer, relaxed ("unstructured crown" 🙄) fabric and fit of these, but don't care for paying the brand premium. Bonus points if they have a range of different embroidered designs or motifs to choose from.
